title: Wire MiniMax H3 ref2va as a separate model - reference to video
description: Ship minimax-h3-ref2va as its OWN ModelDef, not an op on minimax-h3. It is a separate DiT (minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot, 20.97 GB) and MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo has no keyframe path at all - it sets minimax_refs, never minimax_keyframes - so it cannot be folded into fl2va. The graph adopts the i2v workflow: outputs are identical (CONDITIONING + LATENT), so the whole tail reuses unchanged and only the head node swaps. The combinatorial problem is already solved by MpiH3References in ComfyUi-MpiNodes (see brief). Remaining: dep entries pointed at the publisher repos (NEVER re-hosted on R2 - the licence forbids redistribution), the ModelDef, progressStages, the type-consumer sweep, the ref_image_size app control, and the media-slot declarations for 9 image / 3 video / 3 audio inputs. Licence receipts are keyed by licence id, so accepting during a fl2va install already satisfies this model - no second dialog is a FEATURE, not a bug. This card is a 1.4 release blocker (MPI-450 Gate E).
